title: Slider maths
description:
Map between a slider's value and its position in pixels.

```
range 0..100, width 200 px: value 25 -> x 50
x 150 -> value 75
x -10 -> value 0 (clamped)
log range 1..1000: x 100 of 200 -> value 31.6
```
hints: The linear fraction is `t = std::clamp(x / width, 0.0f, 1.0f)` and the value `min + t * (max - min)` (lesson 2.01).
requirements: `toPixel(value, min, max, width)` and `toValue(x, min, max, width)`, clamped to the range.
A logarithmic version for ranges like 1 to 1000 (as `ImGuiSliderFlags_Logarithmic` does).
Integer sliders round to the nearest whole number.
stretch: Add a "drag" mode where moving one pixel changes the value by a speed, with Shift for slower.
